name: Project - Task Assignment

parameters.query: WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_tasks (project_id, title, description, assignee_id, priority, status, due_date, milestone_id) SELECT NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid, COALESCE(NULLIF($2::text, ''), 'Công việc mới'), $3, NULLIF($4::text, '')::uuid, COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text, ''), 'MEDIUM'), 'TODO', NULLIF($6::text, '')::date, NULLIF($7::text, '')::uuid WHERE NULLIF($1::text, '') IS NOT NULL RETURNING id), unassign AS (UPDATE {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_tasks SET assignee_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE NULLIF($1::text, '') IS NULL AND NULLIF($8::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND assignee_id = NULLIF($8::text, '')::uuid AND status != 'DONE' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM ins UNION ALL SELECT id FROM unassign;
SELECT u.mattermost_user_id, p.name as project_name FROM users u, {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_projects p WHERE u.id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid AND p.id = NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid;
